notes.title: Battlecore Robots has launched its Patreon!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44363839/1e6a21d873cf7e22468d1119a9508aa8bf53e677.png[/img]

[b]Dear community,[/b]

We’re so thrilled to tell you that our Patreon page is now live!

[url=https://www.patreon.com/c/battlecorerobots]www.patreon.com/c/battlecorerobots[/url]

Our goal is to develop the best game possible, and for that, we need you. We want to hear your requests and respond to your support accordingly. With that in mind, here is the content of our first build (accessible only to Patrons):

[previewyoutube=avrqRQU7Hv4;full][/previewyoutube]

This first Patreon release focuses on combat. You will have access to a wider variety of maps, Battlecores, guns, melees, bombs, and pods.

Most interestingly, you will be able to test 8 Battlecores—one from each archetype and one illegal. You will be able to play with:

[b]Dart, Taiga, Dark Taiga, V-Man, Harleking, Phoenix, Missy, and Rhino[/b]. If you participated in the last playtest, the last two will definitely catch your eye!

[b]Missy[/b]
[list]
[*]We have improved her Overdrive both technically and visually. When using her Overdrive, Missy will reveal her true form, significantly reducing the cooldown of the weapon she carries.
[/list]
[b]Rhino[/b]
[list]
[*]A brand-new Battlecore! Despite being very slow, his high defense and stamina make him a great choice for melee combat. With his Overdrive, he will smash any enemy in front of him.
[/list]
In addition to the Battlecores, you will have access to the following rotation of pieces and maps:

[list]
[*][b]Maps:[/b] Tutorial Map, Training Arena, Training Arena Blue, Training Arena Red, Hazard Zone, Night Core, Warehouse, Crimson Arena, Ethereal Stand
[*][b]Guns:[/b] G-Shield, Love, Sniper, Blaster, Spiral Illegal, Dragon Flame
[*][b]Melees:[/b] B0NK, Rising Dragon, Flash Claws, Axe, Void Grasp
[*][b]Bombs:[/b] Nuke, Twinkle Star, Lightspear, Stuncross, Fearquake, Acid Strike
[*][b]Pods:[/b] Dragonfly, Aerial Shock, Ping Pong, Aerial Shock Illegal, Lurker, Shock Trap
[*][b]Chips:[/b] Basic, Hunter, Cerberus, Gatling, Warrior, Speed, Fortress, Berserker
[/list]
And that’s a quick summary! We are very excited about this new journey. We’ve poured our hearts into this project, and we can’t wait to share it with you. Your support will help us bring [i]Battlecore Robots[/i] to life and make it the best game it can be.

Let’s build the future of [i]Battlecore Robots[/i] together!

notes.title: Battlecore Robots: A New Path to Launch
notes.notes:
Dear Battlecore Robots fans,

It’s been three years filled with incredible moments, challenges, and learning experiences. From intense battles to awards and festivals, we’ve come a long way together. We even managed to trend in Japan the day we launched this page.

However, despite our efforts, we weren’t able to secure a publisher to ensure the project's sustainable future.

[h3][b]A New Approach: Battlecore Roguelite[/b][/h3]

Between April and November 2024, we redefined the game by incorporating a roguelite mode. Now, you’ll explore the Battlecore Net, a world in crisis where a virus has taken control of pilots and their Battlecore.

[b]Key Features:[/b]

[list]
[*] Unlock unique parts and upgrade your Battlecore.
[*] Create new weapon and ability combinations.
[*] Discover new characters and fight against challenging bosses.
[*] Explore arenas with dynamic and evolving mechanics.
[/list]

[b]Early Tests and Community Feedback[/b]
In November, we conducted a closed test with a small group of community players. The response was overwhelmingly positive, motivating us to make this experience the core of the game.

[h3][b]The Future of the Project and Our Request[/b][/h3]

We are a small indie team of five developers, and creating a game of this scale without funding is a huge challenge. To keep going, we’ve made an important decision:

We’re about to launch a support campaign on Patreon. (Check out our Discord community for details on how you can support us.)

With your help, we’ll be able to complete the game and release a full version by the end of 2025. Additionally, we will update the demo with the first version of the roguelite mode for early supporters.

[h3][b]Try the Demo in the Steam Co-Op Fest[/b][/h3]

From February 10 to 17, you’ll be able to play new and improved content in the Steam demo.

[b]Key Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] Smoother movement.
[*] New combo system.
[*] Improved weapon visual feedback.
[*] New Battlecore, weapons, and arenas.
[*] New interface and progression system.
[/list]

[b]How You Can Help Us:[/b]
If you enjoy Battlecore Robots and appreciate our work, here are some ways you can support us:

[list]
[*] Share this announcement with other players.
[*] Follow us on Steam and add the game to your wishlist.
[*] Join our community on Discord.
[*] Check our community to learn how to become a patron through Patreon.
[/list]

Thank you for being part of this journey. See you in the arena!
